description: This file defines a provider class for managing serialization codecs, copiers, and activators within the Orleans framework. It handles registration, lookup, and instantiation of various serializer components, supporting extensibility and dependency injection.

classes.name: CodecProvider
classes.description: Sealed class providing access and management for serializers, copiers, and activators, supporting dependency injection, dynamic creation, and registration of codecs and related components.

methods.name: TryGetCodec
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a typed codec for a given type, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: GetCodec
methods.description: Retrieves a codec for the specified type, throwing if not found.

methods.name: GetActivator
methods.description: Returns an activator instance for creating objects of type T.

methods.name: TryCreateCodecInstance
methods.description: Creates an untyped codec instance for a given type, considering various scenarios including array, enum, surrogate, and base type codecs.

methods.name: GetServiceOrCreateInstance
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a service instance from DI or creates a new one via ActivatorUtilities.
